forecasts.question: Will AGI be developed before 1 January 2030?
forecasts.key_change: → Stable; Metaculus median mid-2030; no major capability announcements today

factors_up.factor: Altman/Amodei suggest AGI-level systems by late 2026-2027
Musk claims AGI by 2026, tech acceleration continues

factors_down.factor: Metaculus definition requires robotics, pushing timeline out
3.75 years is short; no lab has publicly claimed AGI yet

key_uncertainties: Definition of AGI varies widely across forecasting platforms
Whether current scaling approaches hit diminishing returns
update_triggers: UP: Major lab announces AGI-level benchmark performance
DOWN: Evidence of scaling plateau or major safety pause

forecasts.question: Will economic consultancy lose ≥33% value/jobs by end 2030 due to AI?

forecasts.base_rate: No historical precedent for >33% industry decline in <5 years from technology

factors_up.factor: McKinsey cut 5,000 roles since 2023; AI agents now outnumber new hires
65% of enterprises say traditional consulting losing value

factors_down.factor: BCG AI consulting = 20% of revenue; firms pivoting not collapsing
McKinsey planning 12% headcount increase in 2026

key_uncertainties: Whether AI replaces consulting revenue or creates new consulting categories
Speed of enterprise AI adoption vs consultant-mediated adoption
update_triggers: UP: Major firm reports >15% YoY revenue decline attributed to AI
DOWN: Consulting revenue grows despite AI adoption

Whether services inflation decelerates faster than expected
